<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum lists the chemical shift (δ) values for each carbon signal. Duplicate values indicate equivalent carbons. The distinct δ values are: 168.30, 130.70, 130.27, 128.35, 126.66, 124.85, 123.57, 58.70, 36.40, and 26.40. That gives 10 unique carbon environments.</thought>
